new_material_candidates.name: FTRL — Feedback-Driven Tool-Use Improvements in Large Language Models via Automated Build Environments
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Provides an executable learned tool-use comparator built around automated training-environment construction, verifiable rewards for tool precision and task completion, trajectory collection, and reinforcement-learning updates.

reference_or_screened.name: CoEvolve
reference_or_screened.relevance: Closes the loop between agent rollouts and the training-data distribution by extracting failure signals, synthesizing targeted tasks, validating them through interaction, and retraining the policy.
reference_or_screened.reason: The public repository verified in this bounded pass primarily exposes project documentation rather than a complete executable implementation sufficient for governed baseline reproduction.

reference_or_screened.name: SYNTHAGENT
reference_or_screened.relevance: Synthesizes tool-use tasks and simulated environments and uses rubric-based rewards for agent training.
reference_or_screened.reason: Its primary distinguishing contribution is synthesis of tasks, tools and environments; adding it as a second policy comparator would require demonstrating a materially different matched policy identity beyond the already preserved WebFactory/FTRL-style training pipelines.

reference_or_screened.name: CANDI
reference_or_screened.relevance: Performs selective test-time adaptation for multivariate time-series anomaly detection under distribution shift.
reference_or_screened.reason: The governed E2 candidate pool is centered on structured/tabular prediction, acquisition, optimization and tabular adaptation; multivariate anomaly-detection streams require a separately declared matched E2 experiment before becoming claim-bearing.

reference_or_screened.name: BETA
reference_or_screened.relevance: Provides black-box test-time adaptation using a local steering model and prediction harmonization.
reference_or_screened.reason: Useful black-box TTA evidence, but it is workshop-level rather than archival main-conference evidence and does not currently displace the extensive peer-reviewed E3 claim-bearing pool.

reference_or_screened.name: Dual-Modality Anchor-Guided Filtering
reference_or_screened.relevance: Uses text and adaptive image anchors to filter informative augmented views for VLM test-time prompt tuning.
reference_or_screened.reason: No official executable implementation was independently verified during this bounded pass.

n_h2_reference_research.name: CoEvolve
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Demonstrates closed-loop evolution of an agent policy and its training-data distribution from interaction feedback.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: The evidence concerns agent-policy improvement within AppWorld/BFCL-style agent environments, not one learned decision mechanism transferred across E1, E2, and E3.

n_h2_reference_research.name: FTRL
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Learns stronger tool-use behavior through stable generated environments and verifiable RL feedback.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: No evidence establishes transfer of the learned tool-use policy into structured-ML or vision decision families.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Relational Task Extrapolator
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Learns relational task transformations for extrapolation.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: No verified result demonstrates one common learned decision mechanism spanning E1, E2, and E3.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Learning-To-Measure
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Meta-learns feature-acquisition behavior across structured-data tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: Its demonstrated transfer remains within structured-data active feature acquisition.

stopping_rule.reason: The bounded refinement discovered FTRL as a materially distinct, peer-reviewed, executable E1 tool-use RL comparator absent from prior governed Task-8 candidate identities.
